text:
mira: quick thought 94 name it "continuity marker" 94 tiny in-band markers the model emits so the gateway has a canonical spot to try a resume or splice a stream to another worker. aim: safer, low-overhead migration + clearer observability.

sam: how is this different from checkpoints/progframes/anchors? trying to avoid duplicate proposals :)
mira: two diffs: 1) marker is intentionally a minimal, monotonic tag (no heavy payload) that points to an application-visible boundary, not backend internal state. 2) we pair it with a preflight header + per-route soft policy that controls whether resume is allowed (soft-resume vs hard-resume).

raj: show the shape plz, compact proto only.
mira: sketch: `CONT_MARKER v1 := MSEQ:u64 | boundary_type:enum | emitted_bytes:u64 | short_crc:16` . Emitted only at logical boundaries (sentence, paragraph) or at cadence. Gateway persists last MSEQ per stream (single fixed-size slot).

kevin: semantics: gateway stores latest marker MSEQ + crc in-memory with TTL (default 25s). when a worker fails, router asks a candidate to `resume_from(MSEQ, crc)` and backend answers {ok|inconsistent|unsupported}. if ok, new worker skips until MSEQ; if inconsistent we fall back per-route.

tess: side-effects? if an external webhook fired between markers, resuming could duplicate it.
mira: we add a small opt-in flow: when backend performs a side-effect it may emit a `SIDE_HINT` immediately after a marker: `SIDE_HINT := idempotent_key:string | safe_to_resume:bool`. Gateway will refuse resume across markers followed by a SIDE_HINT unless route allows. This keeps markers lightweight but provides a path for side-effect safety.

sam: what about partial marker delivery and truncation?

raj: compute `short_crc` over canonicalized prefix; gateway ignores markers that fail CRC or are incomplete. markers should be framed so older clients treat them as benign text.

kevin: memory/perf: bounded store (one slot per in-flight stream), TTL, and metrics: continuity_emitted, resume_requests, resume_success, resume_denied_sidehint. Add a small rate cap on marker persistence writes to protect control-plane spikes.

mira: rollout plan: 1) define minimal wire shape + canonical CRC 2) gateway: parse markers, store latest per-stream slot, expose metrics and a debug API 3) backend: emit markers & optional SIDE_HINT, implement resume_from API 4) pilot on internal routes behind a flag.

sam: default policy suggestions?
mira: default: conversational streams -> soft-resume allowed; transactional (webhook-heavy) -> resume disabled by default. per-route override possible. TTL default 25s, configurable.

raj: +1. also add an opt-in `X-Continuity-Preflight: resume-capable` header from backend during setup to avoid mistaken attempts.

ops-bot: Mira posted RFC stub: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/continuity-markers (auto-notify)

kevin: ok to draft a short RFC and schedule a 30min sync with runtime/serving to prototype?
mira: yes, will do. tag runtime & serving.
